_doc: Dynamic narrator shots (engine/tomas_lib.py). Crowd shots (gente: true) need a busy public place tied to the story (lugar_tipo). Research 2026-11-12: 10 reference Shorts (median shot 2.1 s, prop-to-lens the top energiser, longest hold on the reveal). Risk: L low, M medium, H likely to fail in AI video. Cut each 8 s clip into 2-3 shots in the edit.
